performance.verdict: $675 spent, zero leads 28 days — tracking failure confirmed, not ad failure.

findings.text: lead_drought flag confirmed: 0 leads across 28 days and $675.14 Google spend. 138 clicks reached the site — conversion tracking or call routing is broken, not the ads.
OVERDUE: 5 milestones unverified as of 2026-08-31 — GHL build gaps, Stripe QA, end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, UGC batch — all blocking attribution and scaling.
3-day spend signal (Aug 29–31: $1.38, $6.86, $53.34) is erratic vs prior 3 days ($19.69, $21.62, $1.38): no stable daily budget rhythm; spend on Aug 31 spiked to $53.34 with still zero leads.

GBP drove 50 actions (49 directions, 1 web click, 0 calls) in 28 days — calls field is zero despite active search campaign targeting calls, suggesting call routing or number tracking misconfiguration.

GHL shows 128 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments in 28 days against 0 CRM-attributed leads — pipeline has intake activity but no ad source match; this is a CRM mapping gap, not an ads volume problem.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads call-conversion tracking and landing page destination immediately — $675.14 spent, 0 conversions confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has consumed $675.14 over 28 days across 138 clicks and the top campaign 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' ($395.15) with zero conversions recorded. Immediately verify: (1) the call conversion action is active and the tracking number is correctly routed in Google Ads, (2) the landing page destination URL is live and loads correctly, and (3) GBP call tracking is configured — GBP shows 49 direction actions but 0 calls despite a call-focused campaign. Success is confirmed when at least one test call is logged as a conversion in Google Ads by 2026-09-04.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget scaling until conversion tracking fix confirmed; re-check 3-day lead signal on 2026-09-04.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend is running at $19.49/day (7-day avg) with zero leads for 28 consecutive days. No scaling or budget shifts are defensible until the conversion tracking fix (S1) is verified. Re-check on 2026-09-04: if the 3-day lead signal still reads zero after the fix, pause 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' pending creative or landing page review. If leads appear, assess CPL vs the client's own baseline before any scale move.

suggestions.text: Complete end-to-end stack re-test and paid landing page go-live — both overdue 2026-08-31, blocking attribution.
